items.quote: My review is based solely on the wood carpentry. We're delighted with the final result of our Santorini-inspired kitchen! We had a few requests along the way and they were handled well.

A good reliable and quality Carpentry is tough to find. I present to you the exception; H&D Florida Carpentry is a professional and diligent company. As a Home Remodeling contractor, I've referred them to multiple clients who've all been very happy with the scope and quality of the work.

Incredible work by H&D Florida Carpentry on my kitchen! From day one, they were very professional and attentive to every detail. The quality of the materials and craftsmanship is outstanding. They captured exactly the vision I had in mind.
